notes: Peñarol's matches as CURCC (1900–1913) are included, as RSSSF counts them. Annulled matches are left out; walkovers count as a 1–0 win.

Official matches are the Uruguayan league and tournaments, the CONMEBOL cups and the cups played with Argentina's clubs, as RSSSF totals them. Named cups and pre-season tournaments, such as the Copa Bimbo and the Serie Río de la Plata, are under friendlies.
Scorers in each match are not listed by the source; the all-time scorers come from Spanish Wikipedia and include goals in annulled matches.
friendliesNote: Many of them were played for a trophy.
